summary: Positions 72-138 (67). Haiku: 15 photo, 9 unsure/skip with a lead, rest empty-lead skips. Checked 15 photo: 7 fine (keep_ok), 5 field fixes on 4 entries (palais-des-congres-de-tours, 51-astor-place, centre-civic-de-riudaura, paul-mellon-arts-center), 1 wrong (olympic-roof-munich, duplicate of munich-olympic-stadium), 3 with main photo problems (tour-horizons and centre-civic-de-riudaura have a better photo, william-l-slayton-house has none). So 14 kept entries remain, of which 3 need a photo change (slayton-house held for photo).
